environment.description: Production deployment on EKS cluster running Django 4.2 with PostgreSQL 15. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with SDK key sdk-prod-a8f2c. The feature flag 'use-optimized-search' is currently set to TRUE for all users (100% rollout) as part of ongoing performance benchmarking. Application is exposed via AWS ALB with no WAF attached. Database user has SELECT permissions on all tables.
